From: Elena Morales <elena@greenleafhealth.com>

Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter for renewal + expansion PO

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to proceed. Procurement asked that I confirm our renewal cutoff and the exact SOC 2 coverage we can provide. Our renewal is slated for 09/23/2027 and we plan to submit an expansion PO referencing next quarter capacity. Before we create the PO, procurement needs: 

- The latest SOC 2 Type II report (report period dates clearly stated)
- If the current Type II report does not include coverage through our renewal date (09/23/2027), a bridge letter / interim attestation that bridges the gap
- Confirmation of whether Redwood will accept a short interim attestation plus the Type II (if full coverage not available)

Can you also confirm whether your report covers the period Jan 1, 2026–Dec 31, 2026, or if it is a rolling window that ends later? Procurement has a hard internal cutoff of 09/27/2027 for PO acceptance.

We also attached our procurement timeline for visibility. Please let me know the soonest we can receive the report or a bridge letter. If you need anything from our side (evidence points, contact for legal), loop them in.

Best,
Elena
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Greenleaf Health

[Attachment: Greenleaf-Procurement-Timeline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter for renewal + expansion PO

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the timeline. Looping in Markus and Ben to coordinate security sign-off and procurement support.

Short answers up front:
- We can provide the finalized SOC 2 Type II report for period 01/01/2026–12/31/2026.
- Our next Type II window closes 06/30/2027 with reports typically issued ~90 days after close, so there is a chance coverage won't fully extend to your 09/23/2027 renewal cutoff.
- We do provide a limited-scope bridge letter / interim attestation to confirm control continuity for customers in renewal windows; Security needs to sign the letter.

Next steps we propose:
1) I will send the 01/01/2026–12/31/2026 Type II report (redacted stub) within this thread today.
2) Draft bridge letter attached — please review the language (not final) and indicate any required control calls-out procurement needs (e.g., data encryption-at-rest, access reviews).
3) If Procurement will accept interim attestation + Type II report, confirm and we'll prepare the DocuSign.

Attachment: Draft-bridge-letter-Redwood-2027.docx (draft — Security review required).

If you need an accelerated timeline, let us know and we can prioritize Security review (Markus, Ben — can we expedite?).

Thanks,
